title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant B (Cat Yellow as primary surface)

variant.role: one captured trait amplified — color-ladder re-weighting
variant.bet: Cat Yellow promoted to primary surface; finance band inverted to dark; no motion; no IA change

palette.proportions: INVERTED — Cat Yellow as primary surface (hero ground + service tile ground + locations eyebrow); dark as inverted finance band; warm stone as quiet band; page itself stays white
palette.catYellowDeployment: primary surface (hero, service tiles, locations eyebrow) + CTA + eyebrow + 1px border
palette.rationale: uplift-questions.md § Variant B — Cat Yellow is Caterpillar's protected dealer identity (71,464 occurrences in captured; usedAs: ['background','border'] only); 10× under-deployed relative to neutrals. B's bet promotes it to primary surface without changing the captured palette set.

contrastVerification.wcag: FAIL — never use white text on yellow

contrastRules: Never use white text on yellow ground (1.95:1 fail).
Always use dark #272727 on yellow surfaces.
CTAs on yellow surfaces invert to dark ground + yellow text (12.6:1).

heroBand.headlineFont: Roboto Condensed 700 ALL-CAPS at display size (61px desktop)

cta.rationale: Inverted CTA for contrast within yellow surface

heroBand.imageDeployment: captured hero photograph becomes secondary right-aligned 5/3 inset panel within the yellow band; yellow ground IS the primary surface

financeBand.rationale: yellow → dark → yellow rhythm; prevents yellow-fatigue between hero and service tiles

serviceTileRow.rationale: The most striking inversion; service tiles become yellow plates with dark glyphs — Caterpillar's equipment-plate vocabulary on the page surface

partnerSentimentBand.rationale: Quiet band between two yellow surfaces; improvement #2 retained

locationsBand.narrativeProofPosition: yellow eyebrow strip above the dark map
locationsBand.rationale: Yellow eyebrow anchors locations as wayfinding surface; improvement #4 narrative-proof retained

heroOffer.note: Yellow hero IS the finance headline surface; finance cards land in immediate next band; finance visible above the fold across 2 viewports at 1440×900

iaPriorityCheck.verdict: PASS — IA priority preserved; yellow hero does not push finance below the fold

rejectedMoves: Invented color (palette set unchanged; only proportions shift)
Motion register (B is composition / palette, not motion)

whatBIsNot: Not 'make it more yellow everywhere'. Yellow lives on load-bearing surfaces only (hero, service tiles, locations eyebrow); quiet bands stay neutral; finance band intentionally inverts to dark to prevent yellow-fatigue.
Not a rebrand. Palette set unchanged; typography unchanged; component shapes unchanged.
Not a motion variant. Static — no marquee, no count-up, no split-flap, no reveal.
